'''Dan Mailloux Strangle''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Dan Mailloux]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls120.htm Strangle], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001030052636/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls120.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
